circuit.name: Flyback DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Isolated DC-DC converter using a transformer for energy storage and transfer. Converts 12V input to 12V isolated output with galvanic isolation using a step-up transformer (Ns=1.6).

requirements.requirement: Meet target Vout across line (Vin) and load changes
Dynamic response: step changes (line/load) with minimal overshoot and fast settling

data.name: rise_time_10_90
data.spice_command: TRIG [VOUT] VAL={{{{0.1*{criteria.target_vout}}}}} RISE=1 TARG [VOUT] VAL={{{{0.9*{criteria.target_vout}}}}} RISE=1

outputs.description: Time margin between end of demagnetization and next cycle

requirements.requirement: Efficiency across load points with loss breakdown
Stress & thermal margins for key devices
